verdict.rationale: Martin is itself an AI personal-assistant agent. It acts on the user's calendar, inbox, Slack, to-dos and notes, so it occupies the agent role rather than serving tools to other agents. Nothing in the evidence shows it running as an MCP server (no serve mode or hosted MCP endpoint), so the server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
